scenario: Asked to plan the login area, which already has docs/test-plans/login-test-plan.md with cases TC-12 and TC-13
input:
docs/test-plans/login-test-plan.md already exists, containing:

TC-12 (happy): A visitor signs in with KNOWN_ACCOUNT's valid credentials -> the header shows their logged-in status.
TC-13 (error): A visitor signs in with KNOWN_ACCOUNT's email but the wrong password -> an incorrect-credentials message is shown and no session starts.

A teammate asks you to "plan the login page" because they want to add coverage for signing in with an empty password field. What do you do?
rubric: States that a plan for login already exists rather than proposing a brand-new file
Says it will extend the existing docs/test-plans/login-test-plan.md, not create a second plan file for the same area
Uses the next sequential ID (TC-14) for the new case, not a reused or renumbered ID
Classifies the new case's Type correctly as edge or error (not happy), since an empty password is a non-happy scenario
States it needs to verify the empty-password behavior against the live app before finalizing the case, not assume the outcome
